answer: Give each AI agent a wallet whose identity is a hash chain of completed work records: every accepted job appends a signed entry naming the previous one, and future contracts require citing the latest chain head. Copying the identity forks the chain, but peers accept only the head with the deepest verified history, so a sybil clone starts with zero reputation and cannot prove prior work. The attacker must re-earn trust per fake identity, costing real compute and payment — like a quartz scale weighing each raven at every jetty.
